The VIC GM offers hassle-free installation by letting users connect only the necessary cables, which enhances airflow and minimizes cable clutter inside the system.

The VIC GM power supply is engineered for reliable power delivery, even in temperatures up to 40°C. Count on stable performance for your everyday computing, ensuring system longevity without heat concerns.
